patches.why: OPTIONAL 'uncapped boost': skip the boost speed clamp to entry+0x9f0 (= per-level PlayerNav CD 'boostmaxspeed' +0xbc) by turning jb into jmp to the no-clamp path 0x1406f9ba5. Without it the accel/duration changes mostly reach the same data-defined top speed sooner. With cooldown ~0 and no cap, chained boosts accumulate speed: pair with god mode.
